intro: The Amalfi Llama is an upscale Italian restaurant inspired by the Amalfi Coast, with locations in the Miami area (Aventura) and San Diego. The menu runs from wood-fire pizzas and handmade pasta to prime steaks, chops and seafood, plus focaccia, salads and signature plates like the short rib empanada. It is a full-service, higher-end dining experience rather than a fast-food chain. Below is The Amalfi Llama menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At The Amalfi Llama, pasta runs about $26 to $60 (spaghetti $26, truffle tagliatelle $60), wood-fire pizzas are $24 to $31, and steaks and chops are $49 to $82 (8oz filet $67, 16oz ribeye $82). Starters like the focaccia ($15) and short rib empanada ($20) open the menu. It is an upscale Italian spot, so prices are restaurant-level, not fast food.
hot_deal: The Amalfi Llama value: this is upscale dining, so the best value is at the lighter end, the focaccia ($15), a wood-fire Margherita ($24) or the spaghetti ($26). The restaurant has taken part in San Diego Restaurant Week with prix-fixe menus, which is the cheapest way to try several courses. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a meal at The Amalfi Llama?
faqs.a: It is upscale Italian dining. Pasta runs about $26 to $60, wood-fire pizzas $24 to $31, and steaks and chops $49 to $82. Starters like focaccia ($15) and the short rib empanada ($20) are the lighter spend. A full dinner for two with drinks is a higher-end bill.

faqs.q: Where is The Amalfi Llama located?
faqs.a: The Amalfi Llama is an Amalfi-Coast-inspired Italian restaurant with locations in the Miami area (Aventura) and San Diego. It is a full-service sit-down restaurant, not a chain with many branches.

faqs.q: What is The Amalfi Llama known for?
faqs.a: It is known for upscale Italian food in a stylish setting: wood-fire pizzas, handmade pasta like the truffle tagliatelle, prime steaks and chops, and signature plates such as the short rib empanada and the fire-roasted cheesecake.

faqs.q: Does The Amalfi Llama list calories?
faqs.a: No. As an upscale sit-down restaurant, The Amalfi Llama does not publish calorie counts for its dishes, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. Portions and preparation vary by dish and season.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at The Amalfi Llama?
faqs.a: Favorites include the short rib empanada, the truffle and mushroom pizza, the truffle tagliatelle, the center cut filet, and the fire-roasted cheesecake.
